bio: Deep in a Catalan village, local lad, Pierre-Louis Marin, in the dining room, and chef Yvon Rossignol, celebrate first and foremost regional produce courtesy of textbook technique and a distinct weakness for truffles. Their signature is a daring, yet accomplished vacherin-inspired extravaganza of melon, serrano ham and Rivesaltes liqueur. Authentic and bursting with flavour. Attractive lunchtime menu....
